item.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Services Appliance Unauthenticated Code Injection (CVE-2021-44529)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2021-44529. Status: Weaponized (unauthenticated command execution with output returned in the HTTP response). Affects: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Services Appliance (EPM CSA), formerly LANDesk Cloud Services Appliance. Tags: ivanti, endpoint-manager, cloud-services-appliance, code-injection, php, cookie-injection, unauthenticated, cwe-94, kev, rce.
